insights.one_liner: TCWGlobal is a San Diego-based firm handling payroll, compliance and employer-of-record services for contingent workers; it is not a recognised visa sponsor.

culture.text: TCWGlobal handles onboarding, payroll, benefits and compliance for companies using contractors and other contingent workers.
It is headquartered in San Diego with about 505 people on LinkedIn, mostly in operations, sales, HR and customer support.
Staff mostly come from Californian universities like San Diego State University and UC San Diego.

open.text: TCWGlobal is not on the IND list of recognised visa sponsors.
Its one current job here, a senior finance role listed for the Netherlands, needs no Dutch but drew about 200 LinkedIn applicants.

growth.text: Founded in 2010, it lists about 505 employees on LinkedIn.
